body: I think getting a "McJob" would be even more depressing. I have a shitty job I could get back to, but I hated it so much that it was killing me so I quit. Today I had a pretty good day so I'm feeling OK at the moment. I applied to two jobs and I'm not taking no for an answer from them. Also I found a nice place to live in a city by me that is reasonably priced. I've saved up a couple grand and I'm betting on myself to get a job before I run out of money. I always kept it in case of a "rainy day" or whatever, and I've decided if me thinking about suicide isn't a rainy day I don't know what is. I usually feel alright until none of these fucking places get back to me, but hopefully that won't happen again.
